description: Says which rules an e-invoice passed, by which validator and release: the file is held to the rule set its specification identifier (BT-24) names, Factur-X and ZUGFeRD by Mustang, XRechnung (CII and UBL) by the KoSIT validator, and each check (syntax, schema, every named rule set) comes back with its own result and findings. Pass exactly one source: render_id, an e-invoice this workspace rendered, which is answered from the report the render keeps and costs nothing; path, an XML file on this machine; or xml_base64, the XML itself. An XML takes one of the organisation's validations of the day (from the Starter plan; Free validates no uploads). Up to 4 MB of CII or UBL; a PDF is not taken. result is passed, failed or not_checked: not_checked means no rule set here is for the file (reason and explanation say why, such as an identifier it does not know), not that the file is wrong. The report says which rules a file passed; it does not say whether the document is a proper invoice for VAT purposes. To check an _invoice block before rendering it, use check_invoice.

path.description: Absolute path of an e-invoice XML on this machine; counts one of the day’s validations

render_id.description: rnd_ id of a render of this workspace that made an e-invoice; free

rules.description: auto (default) takes the rule set the file's identifier names; a rule set named here judges only a file whose identifier it is for. en16931 holds a render's EN 16931 invoice to CEN's own rules, which counts like an upload

xml_base64.description: The e-invoice XML (CII or UBL), base64 encoded, up to 4 MB; counts one of the day’s validations

name: validate_einvoice

allowance.description: What the day's validations have used after this call; null where nothing was counted

warnings.description: How many warnings the check found

customization_id.description: The specification identifier (BT-24) the file names

reason.description: Why it was not checked, such as unknown_customization_id

result.description: passed, failed or not_checked; new values may be added

rules.description: The rule set and its release, as the validator names it

validator.description: The validator and its version, e.g. KoSIT validator 1.6.3

xml_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the XML that was judged

title: Validate an e-invoice
